description: Source code for H264 VAAPI video decoder delegate in Chromium, handling video decoding, encryption, and slice processing using VAAPI.

classes.name: H264VaapiVideoDecoderDelegate
classes.description: Delegate class for H264 decoding using VAAPI, managing slice processing, encryption, and surface output.

methods.name: CreateH264Picture
methods.description: Creates a new H264 picture object with VA surface.

methods.name: ProcessSPS
methods.description: Stores SPS NALU data for later use.

methods.name: ProcessPPS
methods.description: Stores PPS NALU data for later use.

methods.name: SubmitFrameMetadata
methods.description: Submits SPS, PPS, and frame metadata to VAAPI for decoding.

methods.name: ParseEncryptedSliceHeader
methods.description: Parses encrypted slice header, handling decryption and populating slice header info.

methods.name: SubmitSlice
methods.description: Submits a video slice to VAAPI, handling encryption and reference pictures.

methods.name: SubmitDecode
methods.description: Submits a decoded picture to VAAPI for processing.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state and clears pending buffers.

methods.name: SetStream
methods.description: Sets the stream data and decrypt configuration.

methods.name: FillVAPicture
methods.description: Populates a VAPictureH264 structure from an H264Picture object.
